title: Fixed Cylinder and Open Backframe Display
description: One original complete static cylinder-and-open-backframe equipment display for the fire-station art direction. A true open H-shaped rigid frame with low grounded cradle supports one separate rounded cylindrical exterior, low fixed valve block and two complete wrap bands. Two full broad curved shoulder straps and a continuous low waist-band appearance with blank buckle attach to the rear frame. A single whole curved side hose ends at a parked blank receiver supported on a frame-side bracket. All geometry is newly authored, not a repainted extinguisher or flattened lever-pump backpack sprayer. Four opaque constant PBR roles. One whole prop, zero scenes; no person, mask, markings or instructions. Solid exterior appearance only, not an actual pressure vessel or validated air circuit. No breathing, compressed gas, pressure rating, PPE efficacy, human fit, fire protection, use, manufacture or safety claim.
